_doc: Overrides for scripts/lab-req-gate.mjs; the audit JSON (docs/knowledge/req-coverage-lab.json) is never edited. Keys: '<reqId>|<screen>' (all variant groups of that audit row) or '<reqId>|<screen>|<variants joined>' (one group). Fields: manual (reason, skips automation); screen, variants (replace the audit's); params (URL query); setup (ordered steps: {click|hover|fill:[sel,text]|select:[sel,value]|press:key|goto:url, wait:ms}); expect (Playwright locator expressions, the page. prefix is optional, all must be visible); allowHidden; perVariant {V: {params, setup, expect, manual}}; checks [{screen, variants, params, setup, expect, perVariant}] for composite audit rows that name several screens. mustPass: row keys that must pass under --strict (add a key once its gap is fixed). Rows below the 2026-10-30 marker come from docs/knowledge/req-gate-triage-2026-10-30.md (STALE-CHECK, SETUP, MOVED, PROVISIONAL); prefer 3-part keys so a hint never leaks onto another audit row of the same screen.
